items.title: Your AI bot steps back when you reply
items.why: Answer from Meta Business Suite or another app and Conversation AI goes to sleep. Email replies are not covered yet.

items.title: Meeting Rooms are now HIPAA compliant
items.why: HighLevel says health teams can meet with confidence. Recording now asks for a confirmation before it starts.

items.title: All your events on one website page
items.why: New Events elements list every event, with details and ticket checkout on your site. Turn on Events in Labs first.

items.title: AI agents that know when a meeting starts
items.why: Managed Agents can now run before a meeting starts or after it ends, filtered by calendar and meeting type.

items.title: Smarter dates in your workflows
items.why: Fill date-time contact fields with dynamic values, so reminders and follow-ups land on the right day.
